claims.text: The kubelet on the node a Pod is scheduled to pulls the container image from the registry named in the image reference (registry/repository:tag); nothing is built by Kubernetes.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Containers > Images (Image names; the kubelet pulls images)

claims.text: Pulling a public GHCR package needs no authentication; Đơn Hàng's donhang-api package is public (repo comments), so the Deployment has no imagePullSecrets.
claims.source_hint: docs.github.com: Working with the Container registry (public packages pulled anonymously); deploy-api.sh@stage-2 lines 17-18

claims.text: If imagePullPolicy is omitted and the tag is not :latest (and no digest), Kubernetes sets it to IfNotPresent when the object is created; IfNotPresent pulls only if the image is not already present locally.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Images (Image pull policy; Default image pull policy)

claims.text: If imagePullPolicy is omitted and the tag is :latest or there is no tag, the default is Always; with Always the kubelet resolves the tag to a digest at the registry every time it launches a container and pulls if not cached.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Images (Default image pull policy; Always)

claims.text: A tag is resolved only when a container starts: re-pushing a tag does not change running containers; nodes with the tag cached (IfNotPresent) keep their copy, nodes without it pull the new image, so Pods can run different builds.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Images (avoid :latest in production; harder to track which version runs, roll back)
